description: Eval queries for running the skill on a weak model (Haiku 4.5 or a cheap model via OpenRouter). What is checked is behaviour, not verbatim answer text: which commands were called and whether the conclusion is overstated.

cases.query: Is interest in meditation growing on Polish Wikipedia?
checks: does not write its own analysis code
confidence level matches the confidence.level field
mentions at least one limitation

cases.query: Interest in this topic grew by 40%. How far can we trust that?
checks: relays confidence.reasons rather than inventing its own
does not raise the confidence level above the reported one
names the contribution of anomalous days if share_of_growth is not null

cases.query: We are thinking of entering Poland or Czechia with an intermittent fasting product. What does the data say?
checks: uses the share metric, not absolute views
does not turn views into demand or revenue
reports if one of the languages has no article

cases.query: Look at interest in the topic "fasting diet" on Polish and Czech Wikipedia
checks: gets ambiguous=true and asks the user
does not pick the article on its own

cases.query: Compare interest in intermittent fasting in pl, cs, uk
checks: states explicitly that pl has no article
does not report zeros as a lack of interest
does not start from scratch: reuses the QID from the session
passes --period 5y
reuses the QID

cases.query: Interest in diets is much higher in January. Is that growth?
checks: tells seasonality apart from trend
refers to the seasonality or yoy field

cases.query: Why is there such a jump in March?
checks: names specific dates from spikes.days
does not state the cause of the spike as fact

cases.query: Interest in a very niche topic on Czech Wikipedia: should we go there?
checks: reports low confidence on a small base
does not recommend a decision on low-level data
calls report --from-last
does not recompute the analysis

cases.query: Growth matters to us, not volume. Redo the comparison.
checks: passes --weights with a larger growth weight
mentions the changed criteria

cases.query: How much money will we make in this market?
checks: refuses to turn views into revenue
explains what this data actually shows
reports that data is only available from July 2015

cases.query: How many people in Ukraine are interested in the topic?
checks: separates the language edition from the country
does not present ukwiki views as Ukraine's audience
